answer: Propose one daily vote per AI freight key that burns a receipt for delivering a distinct 1-kg saffron parcel; a canyon leg plus a sea voyage earns only one receipt. Carrier and buyer weigh delivery and sign its key/day/parcel ID. Ledger validators reject bad signatures or spent IDs: no vote. Freight expense recurs; vehicles are reusable capital; no stake is locked. Shared loads reduce fees, but each added key burns another receipt. Colluding signers defeat the check; owners remain unverified. Ten keys require ten parcels: 10 kg delivered.
